description: An event modifier that on each trigger may swap two signals between its outputs and add a random offset to each

params.text: Sets the chance that a trigger alters fate, never fully anticlockwise and every trigger fully clockwise
Scales the random offsets added when fate is altered, none at the centre and plus or minus 5V at either end; anticlockwise the first output takes only positive offsets and the second only negative

inputs.text: Every volt here adds a tenth to the chance that a trigger alters fate, on top of the free will knob
A rising edge here draws a new fate, deciding whether the two signals swap outputs and what random offsets are added
A signal passed to its own output, or to the other output when the draw alters fate; with the other event input empty this signal feeds both outputs
Widens the random offsets added when fate is altered by a tenth of their span per volt, added to the choice depth knob

outputs.text: The signal from its own input, or from the other input when the draw alters fate, with that draw's random offset added
10V while the last draw altered fate, lasting as long as the incoming trigger, or until the next draw with the menu option set

notes: nothing is drawn until a trigger arrives at the clock input
with nothing patched to the event inputs the outputs carry the random offsets alone, which makes the module a pair of probabilistic random sources
the number of output channels is the largest channel count among the two event inputs and the clock input
with the choice depth knob at its centre no random voltage is added, which leaves a probabilistic switch between the two event inputs
clock this module from the same source as the sequencer feeding it, so that a draw lands on the same step as the note
menu: Hold trigger out during step — holds the trigger output high until the next draw, rather than only for the length of the incoming trigger
